# Environment Agency rainfall fixture

`ea-bristol-2026-09-14.json` is a real 96-reading response retrieved on 14 September 2026 from station 531179. Original source metadata and measurement timestamps are retained. The test evaluates freshness relative to the recorded newest timestamp, not today's clock.

Source: https://environment.data.gov.uk/flood-monitoring/id/stations/531179/readings?parameter=rainfall&_sorted&_limit=96

This uses Environment Agency rainfall data from the real-time data API (Beta). Open Government Licence v3: https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/
